title: 🎥 What Makes Sherley Farms in Anna, Texas, Special?
description:
We’re diving into the $1.5 billion master-planned community designed to transform Anna, Texas. From 3,000 homes to a 65-acre farm and trails connecting to downtown, this project is bringing something unique to Collin County.

Question for you: If you had the chance to design your ideal community, what would you include? Share your thoughts in the comments!
